e.summary_en: The server why-lingxi-insurance-mcp, registered in the official MCP registry under a Chinese domain namespace and backed by a repository, **is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market** whose readme opens by stating that it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call. **Measured this round**: the registry holds two version records published on the same day, both active, with a remote endpoint at whylingxi.cn; **this round actually called that endpoint, completing an MCP handshake and retrieving the tool list**, which includes a schema tool, a product search tool, a product detail tool and a comparison tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts**, and **four things are worth reading: the positioning sentence that this is not a marketplace but infrastructure; the tools and field descriptions retrieved by an actual call, including a recommended calling order and a default of not returning reasoning traces; a disagreement between the registry and the repository on coverage counts; and eleven access surfaces including agent-to-agent, an OpenAI-compatible route, an agent card, an OpenAPI description and a plain-text file for language models**. **Only the tool list was called once this round; no quote or underwriting call was made.**
e.body:
**why-lingxi-insurance-mcp**（MCP 注册处 **`cn.whylingxi/insurance`**，**仓库 **`lpb123/whylingxi-insurance-mcp`****）**是一个**面向中国保险市场的 AI 原生保险数据平台****——**仓库 README 逐字标题为**「**WhyLingxi — China Insurance Intelligence Platform**」**，**并逐字划清定位**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**本次实测**：**注册处记录 **`3.1.0` 与** `3.1.1` **两条版本**（**发布时间均为 **2026-06-02T10:23:56Z**、**状态 **active**、**远程端点逐字为** `https://whylingxi.cn/mcp`**）**；**⭐ 本次**实际调用该端点**（**MCP 握手 ＋ **工具清单**）**，**取回工具**逐字含** `get_schema`、`search_products`、`get_product_detail`、`compare_products` 等**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**注册处里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均注册处元数据、仓库 README 与本次实测调用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 定位句逐字把「**不是商城**」写在最前****——**逐字**：**「**面向中国保险市场的 AI 原生保险数据平台。通过统一的 MCP 服务为 AI Agent 提供保险产品搜索、对比、推荐、精确报价与核保预检能力。**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**它先说**自己**不是**什么**（**不是面向人的商城**）**，**再说**自己是**什么**（**面向 Agent 的基础设施**）**——**⭐ 这与第 360 轮那条「**先写这不是什么**」同向**，**而**这里的对象是**产品定位**而不是数据。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 本次调用取回了**工具与字段**，**且带一条**调用顺序**建议****——**实测** `get_schema` **的描述逐字为**「**获取调用策略和字段优先级。调用流程：(1)收集用户age后即可调recommend (2)有health_conditions时自动附带核保结论 (3)include_reasoning默认false，Agent自行组织语言 (4)返回的source_url可直接给用户作为投保链接。**」**；**⭐ 另外三个工具的参数逐字为**：`search_products`（**险种枚举逐字为**医疗险／重疾险／意外险／定期寿险／终身寿险／年金险／旅游险／团险；**另有** age、budget、keyword、limit**）、`get_product_detail`（**product_id ＋ **compact 精简模式**）、`compare_products`（**2 至 5 款对比**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄的地方是**它把**「**先收集什么、**再调什么**」**写进了工具的**返回内容**里**：**⭐ 即**调用顺序**不是**外部文档，**而是**工具自己会告诉你**。**⚠️ 本词条如实指出两处**：**① **`include_reasoning` 默认 false****（**即**默认不返回推理过程，**由 Agent 自己组织语言**）**；**② **返回的 `source_url` 可直接作为投保链接****（**⭐ 即**这是一个**带转化入口**的设计**，**本词条**只如实转述**，**不评判其合规性**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 登记处与仓库的**覆盖数字不一致**（本次实测）**——**注册处描述逐字为**「**Insurance search, recommendation, premium calc & underwriting for China. **65 insurers, 483 products**.**」**（**中文版逐字为**「**保险产品搜索、推荐、保费试算、核保预检。覆盖**65家保司483款产品****」**）**，**而仓库 README 逐字为**「**覆盖 **158 家保司 | 489 款在售产品 | 8 大险种 | 实时精确报价****」**。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两组数字而不替它调和**，**并指出**这是一个**跨登记处与仓库的常见落差**（**⭐ 与第 360 轮记下的**「**登记处描述可能滞后**」同向**）**。**⭐⭐ ④ 接入面被列成一张表，**共 **11 个****——**逐字含**：**MCP（**Streamable HTTP）**、**A2A（**Google Agent-to-Agent，**支持自然语言与结构化两种模式）**、**OpenAI 兼容接口**（**可替代 OpenAI API）**、**REST 对话**、**Agent Card 两处**（`/.well-known/agent.json` 与**别名** `agent-card.json`**）、**OpenAPI 规范**、**MCP Manifest**（`/.well-known/mcp.json`**）、**OpenAI 插件清单**（`ai-plugin.json`**）、**`llms.txt`**、**以及开发文档页**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一组**接入面**值得记**：**⭐ 即**同一个能力**同时披了**面向不同生态的外壳**（**Agent 间、**模型工具调用、**插件、**纯文本说明**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**，**而**这里是**同一个服务**对多种 Agent 协议**各出一版**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 九个工具与四类使用场景被写明**——**README 逐字列出九个工具**（`get_schema`／`search_products`／`get_product_detail`／`compare_products`／`recommend`／`get_premium`／`answer_question`／`check_underwriting`／`chat`**）**，**并逐字给出五类面向 Agent 的场景**（**保险规划、**理财顾问、**家庭保障、**养老规划、**健康咨询**）**与四类面向开发者的接入**（**MCP 集成、**OpenAI 工具调用、**A2A 委托协作、**自定义顾问应用**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**`check_underwriting`（**核保预检**）与**`get_premium`（**精确保费**）**是两个**最接近精算实务**的工具**——**⭐ 而**本次**未调用**它们**（**见下**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-ai-mcp]]、**[[insuranceoracle]]、**[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、**[[insurancea2amcp]] 覆盖面向 Agent 的保险服务**，**[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、**[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、**[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、**[[insurance-recommendation-engine]] 覆盖中国市场一侧**，**[[insurance-qa-en]]、**[[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖保险问答与证据**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一个中国市场 AI 原生保险数据平台：**以 **MCP／**A2A／**OpenAI 兼容**多协议对外、**把调用顺序写进工具描述、**并把**投保链接**作为返回值**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① 产品定位**先写「**我不是什么**」**；**② **调用顺序**最好由工具自己说明**（**而不是**只写在外部文档里）**；**③ **多次登记或多处描述时**要核对数字是否一致**；**④ **同一能力对多种 Agent 协议各出一版**时**要有一张接入面清单**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手与一次工具清单调用**（**未调用任何报价、**核保预检、**推荐或问答工具、**未提交任何个人或健康信息**），**故**不主张**其报价、**核保结论、**产品数据或覆盖数字的准确性**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未读该仓库 README 的全文**（**只读了前段与工具、**接入两张表**）**，**也未读**其文档页、**OpenAPI 规范或 **`llms.txt` 的内容**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**158 家保司／489 款产品**」**与「**65 家／483 款**」**孰为当前**（**⭐ 本词条**只并列两处自述**）**，**也未核实**其数据来源与更新频率**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务的**运营主体、**资质与**定价模式**；**⭐ 并如实指出**：**其返回的** `source_url` **被描述为**可直接用作投保链接**，**而**这一点**在合规上意味着什么**，**本词条**不作判断**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**其**保险知识问答与条款解读**的内容从何而来**（**⭐ 是否引用条款原文、**是否有出处标注**）**——**⚠️ 这对精算与合规用途**至关重要**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实** A2A **与** OpenAI 兼容**两个接入面**是否**与 MCP 端点提供同一套能力**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该服务**是否收集或留存调用方数据**（**⭐ 其**隐私政策**本次**未访问**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ 注册处两条记录的发布时间均为 **2026-06-02****（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**而**本次**实测的是**当下端点**——**⭐ 本词条**如实记录这一处**，**并指出**本条收录的缺口是**「**一个中国市场 AI 原生保险数据平台：**多协议接入 ＋ **把调用顺序写进工具描述**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**不是**保险商城、**也不是**持牌建议渠道**，**其输出**不得**当作投保、**核保或精算判断依据**。

e.body_hk:
**why-lingxi-insurance-mcp**（MCP 註冊處 **`cn.whylingxi/insurance`**，**倉庫 `lpb123/whylingxi-insurance-mcp`****）**是一個**面向中國保險市場的 AI 原生保險資料平台****——**倉庫 README 逐字標題為**「**WhyLingxi — China Insurance Intelligence Platform**」**，**並逐字劃清定位**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**。**本次實測**：**註冊處記錄 `3.1.0` 與 `3.1.1` 兩條版本**（**發布時間均為 2026-06-02、**狀態 active、**遠端端點逐字為** `https://whylingxi.cn/mcp`**）**；**⭐ 本次**實際調用該端點**（**MCP 握手 ＋ 工具清單**）**，**取回工具**逐字含** `get_schema`、`search_products`、`get_product_detail`、`compare_products` 等**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**註冊處裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均註冊處元資料、倉庫 README 與本次實測調用所得）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 定位句把「**不是商城**」寫在最前****——**逐字**「**不是保险商城 —— 是给 AI Agent 调用的结构化保险基础设施。**」**——**⭐ 即**先說自己**不是**什麼，**再說**自己是**什麼**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 本次調用取回**工具與欄位**，**並帶一條**調用順序**建議**——**`get_schema` 描述逐字**「**获取调用策略和字段优先级。调用流程：(1)收集用户age后即可调recommend (2)有health_conditions时自动附带核保结论 (3)include_reasoning默认false，Agent自行组织语言 (4)返回的source_url可直接给用户作为投保链接。**」**；**另三個工具**：`search_products`（**險種枚舉**醫療險／重疾險／意外險／定期壽險／終身壽險／年金險／旅遊險／團險；**另有** age／budget／keyword／limit**）、`get_product_detail`（product_id ＋ compact**）、`compare_products`（**2 至 5 款**）**。**⭐ 即**調用順序**不是外部文檔，**而是**工具自己會告訴你**。**⚠️ 兩處如實指出**：`include_reasoning` **預設 false**；**返回的** `source_url` **可直接作為投保連結**（**⭐ 這是**帶轉化入口**的設計，**只如實轉述**）**。**⭐⭐ ③ 登記處與倉庫的**覆蓋數字不一致**（本次實測）**——**註冊處逐字** 65 insurers, 483 products（**中文版**覆蓋65家保司483款產品**）**，**而**倉庫 README 逐字**覆蓋 158 家保司 | 489 款在售產品 | 8 大險種**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**。**⭐⭐ ④ 接入面 **11 個****：**MCP（Streamable HTTP）**、**A2A**、**OpenAI 相容介面**、**REST 對話**、**Agent Card 兩處（**含別名**）**、**OpenAPI**、**MCP Manifest**、**OpenAI 插件清單**、**`llms.txt`**、**開發文檔**——**⭐ 即**同一個能力**披了**面向不同生態的外殼****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 九個工具與四類場景**：`get_schema`／`search_products`／`get_product_detail`／`compare_products`／`recommend`／`get_premium`／`answer_question`／`check_underwriting`／`chat`**；**⭐ 其中** `check_underwriting`（**核保預檢**）與** `get_premium`（**精確保費**）**最接近精算實務**，**而本次**未調用**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[insurance-ai-mcp]]、[[insuranceoracle]]、[[ai-insurance-multiagent-mcp]]、[[insurancea2amcp]]、[[china-insurance-regulatory-updates]]、[[insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[china-insurance-actuarial-cn]]、[[insurance-recommendation-engine]]、[[insurance-qa-en]]、[[insurance-qa-evidence]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**中國市場 AI 原生保險資料平台：**多協議對外＋**把調用順序寫進工具描述＋**把投保連結作為返回值**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[insuranceoracle]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① 產品定位**先寫「**我不是什麼**」**；**② **調用順序**最好由工具自己說明**；**③ **多處描述時**要核對數字是否一致**；**④ **同一能力對多協議各出一版**時要有一張接入面清單**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**只做了一次 MCP 握手與一次工具清單調用**（**未調用任何報價、**核保預檢、**推薦或問答工具、**未提交任何個人或健康資訊**），**不主張**其報價、**核保結論、**產品資料或覆蓋數字的準確性**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**未讀該倉庫 README 全文**，**也未讀**其文檔頁、**OpenAPI 規範或** `llms.txt` **的內容**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**158 家／489 款**」**與「**65 家／483 款**」**孰為當前**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**該服務的**運營主體、**資質與**定價模式**；**其** `source_url` **被描述為可直接用作投保連結**，**此點在合規上意味什麼**，**本詞條**不作判斷**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**其**問答與條款解讀**的內容來源與出處標註**——**⚠️ 這對精算與合規用途至關重要**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實** A2A **與** OpenAI 相容**兩個接入面**是否提供同一套能力**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**該服務**是否收集或留存調用方資料**（**未訪問其隱私政策**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**註冊處兩條記錄發布時間均為 2026-06-02（**窗口之外**）**，**而**本次實測的是**當下端點**——**如實記錄**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**不是**保險商城、**也不是**持牌建議渠道**，**其輸出不得**當作投保、**核保或精算判斷依據**。

e.body_en:
The server why-lingxi-insurance-mcp, registered in the official MCP registry under a Chinese domain namespace with a GitHub repository, **is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market**, titled as a China insurance intelligence platform and stating in its readme that it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call. **Measured this round**: the registry holds two version records published on the same day in June, both active, with a remote endpoint on the vendor domain; **this round completed an MCP handshake against that endpoint and retrieved the tool list**, which includes a schema tool, a product search tool, a product detail tool and a comparison tool. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry contents, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the repository readme and the call made this round**: **first, the positioning sentence puts what the service is not at the front**: verbatim, it is an artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform for the Chinese market that provides product search, comparison, recommendation, precise premium quotation and underwriting pre-check through a unified service, and **it is not an insurance marketplace but structured insurance infrastructure for agents to call**. **Saying what a product is not before saying what it is, applied to positioning rather than to data, is the most copyable line of this entry.** **Second, the call returned tools with field descriptions and a recommended calling order**: the schema tool states verbatim that after collecting the user age the recommendation tool can be called, that when health conditions are present an underwriting conclusion is attached automatically, that including reasoning traces defaults to false with the agent composing its own wording, and that the returned source URL can be given to the user directly as an application link; the search tool enumerates eight insurance categories and takes age, budget, keyword and a limit; the detail tool offers a compact mode; and the comparison tool covers two to five products. **The calling order is therefore delivered by the tool itself rather than living only in external documentation.** **This entry states plainly that reasoning traces are off by default and that the returned source URL is described as usable as an application link, which is a conversion path; this entry relays that without judging its compliance.** **Third, the registry and the repository disagree on coverage, as measured here**: the registry description states sixty-five insurers and four hundred and eighty-three products, while the repository readme states one hundred and fifty-eight insurers and four hundred and eighty-nine products across eight categories with real-time precise quotation. **This entry records both sets of numbers side by side without reconciling them, and notes that this is a common lag between a registry description and a repository.** **Fourth, the access surfaces are tabulated and number eleven**: a streaming HTTP MCP endpoint, an agent-to-agent endpoint with both natural-language and structured modes, an OpenAI-compatible chat completions route, a REST chat route, an agent card plus a compatibility alias, an OpenAPI description, an MCP manifest, an OpenAI plugin manifest, a plain-text file for language models, and a documentation page. **One capability wearing many shells for different ecosystems is the same shape as a source appearing in several forms, applied here to protocols.** **Fifth, nine tools and four audience situations are listed**: the tools cover schema, search, detail, comparison, recommendation, precise premium, question answering, underwriting pre-check and chat; the agent-facing situations cover insurance planning, wealth advice, family protection, retirement planning and health consultation; and the developer-facing routes cover MCP integration, OpenAI tool calling, agent-to-agent delegation and custom applications. **Of these, the underwriting pre-check and the precise premium tools are the two closest to actuarial practice, and neither was called this round.** **Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover agent-facing insurance services, China-market insurance material and insurance question answering with evidence, **while this entry supplies a China-market artificial-intelligence-native insurance data platform that speaks several agent protocols, puts its calling order inside the tool descriptions, and returns an application link. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled insurance oracle and the pooled compliance-oriented MCP server**; **four practices transfer directly: state what a product is not before what it is; let the tool itself describe the calling order; check whether multiple descriptions agree on the same numbers; and keep a list of access surfaces when one capability is offered under several agent protocols**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, only one MCP handshake and one tool-list call were made** — no quotation, underwriting pre-check, recommendation or question-answering tool was called, and no personal or health information was submitted — **so no claim is made about the accuracy of its quotations, underwriting conclusions, product data or coverage counts**. **Second, the repository readme was not read in full**, only its opening and its two tables, and its documentation page, OpenAPI description and plain-text model file were not read; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, which of the two coverage figures is current was not verified**, and neither was the data source or update frequency behind them. **Fourth, the operating entity, licensing status and pricing model were not verified**; the returned source URL is described as usable as an application link, **and this entry makes no judgement about what that implies for compliance**. **Fifth, where the question-answering and policy-interpretation content comes from, and whether it cites sources, was not verified, which matters greatly for actuarial or compliance use. Sixth, whether the agent-to-agent and OpenAI-compatible surfaces offer the same capabilities as the MCP endpoint was not verified. Seventh, whether the service collects or retains caller data was not verified**, its privacy policy not having been visited. **Eighth, on the window: both registry records were published in June, outside the thaw window, while the endpoint measured here is current, and this entry records that; the gap named for this entry is that an artificial-intelligence-native Chinese insurance data platform offering several agent protocols and putting its calling order inside tool descriptions had no counterpart in the pool. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is neither a marketplace nor a licensed advisory channel and that its output must not be used as a basis for application, underwriting or actuarial judgement.**
